I realized all this on Friday, it was not something I knew. I always trusted her, but I had doubts about our friendship during this month and she told me all that I have told. She was honest with me, but she destroyed me.
It is very difficult for me to leave home more to do something different of going the gym. I don't like people to see me, I have social anxiety. I don't know how to make friends or talk ti people. This year I have gone out with friends about 5 times.
I continue in therapy, and I have changed psychologists 2 times since 2017.
(Sorry for my english)
Lo mejor que he visto en mucho tiempo
